title: Chainwake Boarder
text: Chainwake Boarder swings from cargo cable to cargo cable and lands behind the expedition's guard. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The wake arrives before the ship.

defeatReward.text: Chainwake Boarder is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
